documentation.title: PHPCSUtils Cache Sniff
documentation.standard:
Documentation containing valid and invalid code examples that are correct. Uses a sniff that relies on PHPCSUtils caching. Ensures that the script correctly calls PHPCS programatically by using different filenames for each instance of DummyFile, so that the cache is not shared between different code examples causing incorrect results.
If DummyFile is not called with different filenames, PHPCSUtils cache will be shared for the two code examples below, causing the second code example to be incorrectly marked as valid and causing the test to fail.
